description: Pinned Cameras frontend + fallback ACL sourced from cams-record. Hub-owned camera-access.js and cams.json are NOT in this set.

source.ref_note: cams-record main commit e0059bd (Admin tab, detection type icons). Its apphub/ tree (47e53f6) is byte-identical to the alert-pause branch (PR #10) commit 86e1160, which adds only the per-camera phone alert pause backend outside apphub/; the hub alert pause UI rides as local_patches. Hub core remains server.js + camera-access.js.

reasons: Accept full registry camera id length (1–64) in #cam= hash routes; upstream still uses {0,31} (max 32).
Restore live playback + timeline on pageshow when returning from back-forward cache after pagehide cleared tlCam.

Per-camera phone alert pause: bell control on each camera tile and in the camera player (stays visible in full screen), menu 1 h / 3 h / Until morning / Resume, "Paused until 9:40 PM" badges, and the #alerts view listing every permitted camera (deep link from the App Hub menu). Talks to cams-record /api/push/pauses; controls only for owners/admins (server-enforced). Merged alongside upstream's Admin tab routing in show().

Lightbox snapshot retry: on a failed snapshot load (open or HD toggle) retry once after ~1.5 s with a cache-buster, then fall back to the other resolution if it exists, then show "Snapshot unavailable"; retries are tied to the open event/load so a closed or changed lightbox is never touched. Push-tap (#event=) uses has_snapshot / has_snapshot_hires from cams-record /api/push/event-context (missing = false) instead of hardcoding true; the cams-detect events list stays the fallback.
local_patches.canonical_upstream: Coordinate the max-64 id and bfcache fixes plus the alert pause UI into keto-guido/cams-record apphub/static/cams.js. cams-record alert-pause (PR #10) ships only the backend (/api/push/pauses, push_pauses table, optional MQTT) and leaves apphub/ unchanged; land the same UI in cams-record apphub/, then bump source.commit and clear this entry with sync --write --accept-dropping-local-patches.

reasons: Styles for the phone alert pause (appended after upstream's Admin tab and detection-icon blocks): tile/player bells, paused badge, shared menu, toast and the Alerts view.
local_patches.canonical_upstream: cams-record alert-pause (PR #10) ships only the backend (/api/push/pauses, push_pauses table, optional MQTT) and leaves apphub/ unchanged; land the same UI in cams-record apphub/, then bump source.commit and clear this entry with sync --write --accept-dropping-local-patches.

reasons: Alerts tab (#alerts) and view, camera-page bell + paused badge, shared pause menu and status toast, added to upstream's page markup (Admin tab and views kept).
Bump cams.js?v=19 → v=20 and cams.css?v=15 → v=16: upstream already used v=19/v=15 for different bytes, and the hub previously shipped its own v=19/v=14, so clients must refetch the patched assets.
Bump cams.js?v=20 → v=21 for the lightbox snapshot retry and push-tap snapshot flags fix in static/cams.js.
local_patches.canonical_upstream: Ship with the static/cams.js alert pause UI in cams-record; bump cache versions there. cams-record alert-pause (PR #10) ships only the backend (/api/push/pauses, push_pauses table, optional MQTT) and leaves apphub/ unchanged; land the same UI in cams-record apphub/, then bump source.commit and clear this entry with sync --write --accept-dropping-local-patches.

reasons: Expect cams.js?v=20 / cams.css?v=16 after the cache-bump local patch.
Expect the Alerts tab, #alerts view, player bell, paused badge and shared pause menu markup (upstream Admin assertions kept).
Expect cams.js?v=21 after the snapshot-retry cache bump.
local_patches.canonical_upstream: Follow cams-record when its page test expects the alert pause markup and new asset versions.

notes: run.sh bind-mounts the whole apphub host directory at /app. The Cameras builtin (require('./cams')) and its static/ assets must live in that same directory — never ad-hoc copied from another live tree.
camera_acl.js is the cams.js fallback ACL twin from cams-record; camera-access.js is the hub writer/authorizer. Both must agree on CAMERAS.md / camera_acl_vectors.json decisions.
cams-record and cams-detect mount only the isolated registry directory read-only; they do not supply cams.js into the hub process.

files.*.sha256 are package bytes (including local_patches). Upstream pin bytes for patched files are local_patches[].upstream_sha256. sync --from verifies upstream; package tests verify package hashes.

refresh: node apphub/sync_cams_frontend.js --from /path/to/cams-record-checkout/apphub. Checkout must be the pinned source.commit. --write refuses missing source files and refuses to drop local_patches unless --accept-dropping-local-patches is also passed after a coordinated upstream move.
